image.description: Optional picture of the part, shown on its tile in the workshop and the shop.

slot.description: The key of a slot of the model of the game (rules/model): which ones there are is the model's to say, so the pack checks it, not this schema. The role of the slot decides the rest: the parts of the slot that is the tires have a tire_kind, and the parts of the engine slot an engine; no other part has either.

tire_kind.description: Which column of the tire matrix of the rules the tires use: how well they grip on each surface. Only tires have it, and every tire has it.

stats.description: Base statistics of the model. Rarity and upgrades multiply them at run time.

engine.description: Only the parts of the slot engine have it, and every one of them: the layout and the displacement of the model. The power and the mass of the engine are in stats (power_kw and engine_mass_kg) and follow from the rules of the engines, which a test checks; the car takes its power and its engine mass from the part instead of from its own definition.

requires.description: What the car must have for the part to be put on it: an engine of at least min_cylinders cylinders (the number in the layout of its engine, R4 is 4 and V8 is 8), and, for the parts that only work with a booster (an intercooler), a booster on the car. A job that puts the part on a car that does not meet it is refused.

fits.description: Optional restriction to vehicle classes or powertrains.
